sections.title: Recording
sections.text: Press pad to record (up to 60s). Press again to stop and play. Press to pause, press to resume. CC 20-35 for overdub.

sections.title: Overdub Modes
sections.text: Replace: overwrites. Multiply: endless layering with Decay control. Disintegration: re-applies voice FX each pass — loop dissolves into abstraction.

sections.title: Clock
sections.text: Global speed x0.25 to x2.0 for all voices. Lower speeds introduce sample rate degradation artifacts (Mood mk2 style).

sections.title: Stability
sections.text: Cumulative tape degradation applied to all playing voices. The effect compounds over time — saturation, HF rolloff, noise (Blooper-inspired).

sections.title: Loop Page
sections.text: Knobs: Start, End, Reverse, Saturation, Wow/Flutter, Send, Glitch, Tilt EQ. Menu: Studer 962 EQ (Bass/MidF/MidG/Treble), Pitch, Filter, Pan, Volume, Decay.

sections.title: Glitch
sections.text: Beat-repeat from 1/4 to micro-glitch. Above 0.4: random octave jumps (+/-1, +/-2 oct). Above 0.6: TPDF bit-crush layered on top.

sections.title: Tilt EQ
sections.text: Tonelux-style frequency seesaw. CW: brighter. CCW: warmer. Center freq 800Hz, +/-6dB range.
